edits.before: Poke from the saddle — the attached Q steers and the lane can't bill you for it.
edits.after: Ultra Mega Fire Kick (1200 range) out-pokes your shorter attach-Q at level 1 — he wins every exchange before you can answer.

edits.before: Dismount windows begin: the passive autos shield and heal; schedule them carefully.
edits.after: Q knockback plus his W haste zone wins trades outright — you can't contest without eating the kick.

edits.before: Full rhythm: attach for the trades, dismount for the passive, never linger between.
edits.after: Cozy Campfire's shield-zone blunts every all-in you attempt — his enchanter kit is simply stronger here.

edits.before: Zoomies the margins — the host's tempo is your tempo; bank the chip.
edits.after: His sustain out-heals your poke and denies extended trades through levels 4-5.

edits.before: Final Chapter online — the root waves referee every dive on your host.
edits.after: Breath of Life (R, 160/145/130s) cleanses your jungler's ganks — the CC you'd convert gets undone for free.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the steered Qs chunk.
edits.after: His enchanter shielding still keeps him ahead in the mirror even after your first item.

edits.before: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote the focus fire.
edits.after: Two items deep your untargetable heal-spam and empowered Q finally out-scale his single-target support.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W attach (untargetability) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Milio Breath of Life (160/145/130s cooldown): matchup-defining — the team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain; force it early, engage after. - It also cancels your own Final Chapter channel outright — only cast R once his is spent. - Keep W attach (untargetability) banked for their best play.

edits.before: Steer the Q through the pair, E the trade-back, auto from the passive window — billed, healed, and re-saddled.
edits.after: Land Q through both targets, E the retaliation, then auto during the passive window for a fully healed trade.

edits.before: Lingering dismounted for one more auto — the cat on foot is the game's most honest kill.
edits.after: One extra auto while dismounted is how yuumi players die — remount before you take it.
